setting.codexBeacon.soundFileOnDone: Local WAV/MP3 sound for response completion. Empty follows the common soundFile. The sound and soundOnDone switches still apply.
setting.codexBeacon.soundFileOnQuestion: Local WAV/MP3 sound when Codex needs an answer. Empty follows the common soundFile. Notification and sound switches still apply.
setting.codexBeacon.soundFileOnApproval: Local WAV/MP3 sound when Codex needs approval. Empty follows the common soundFile. Requires a registered and trusted approval hook; notification and sound switches still apply.
setting.codexBeacon.localAutoConfigureAp: Automatically register the approval notification hook after the local collector starts. Review and trust it in Codex settings → Hooks. Disabling this setting keeps the existing hook.
setting.codexBeacon.soundFile: Absolute path to a local WAV or MP3 file on this Windows computer, including for SSH/container projects. Use Customize notification sound to choose a file. Empty uses the system sound; unreadable or unsupported audio falls back to it. Applies to response, approval and question alerts. Restart VS Code once after upgrading an older notification broker.
command.codexBeacon.checkInstallation: Check / install components for this environment
command.codexBeacon.showEntry: Open session and mark this notification read
command.codexBeacon.configureApprovalHoo: Configure approval reminders for this environment
command.codexBeacon.removeApprovalHook: Remove approval reminders for this environment
command.codexBeacon.clearPrivateData: Clear notification data in this environment and on this computer
command.codexBeacon.clearLocalPrivateDat: Clear all local notification caches only
configuration.title: Session Notifier
setting.codexBeacon.notificationsEnabled: Enable alerts. Turning this off still records notification history.
setting.codexBeacon.desktopNotifications: Show Windows desktop notifications. Do Not Disturb may suppress them.
setting.codexBeacon.sound: Play notification sounds using the custom audio file or Windows system sound.
setting.codexBeacon.soundVolume: Volume for all notification sounds and previews (0–100%). 0 mutes sound; system and other application volumes are unchanged.
setting.codexBeacon.taskbarAttention: Show yellow/red taskbar attention and a status prefix in window preview titles. Adds a title variable on first use; read notifications clear the indicator.
setting.codexBeacon.blinkWindowTitle: Alternate the unread title dot every 0.8 seconds until read. Does not play sound, steal focus or flash the whole thumbnail background.
setting.codexBeacon.notifyOnDone: Notify when the current response ends.
setting.codexBeacon.notifyOnApproval: Notify when approval is required. Requires a configured and trusted approval hook.
setting.codexBeacon.notifyOnQuestion: Notify when a structured question tool call is detected.
setting.codexBeacon.onlyWhenUnfocused: Alert only while the window is in the background; foreground events still enter history.
setting.codexBeacon.autoReadOnWindowFocu: Off by default: returning to a window preserves unread state, and a notification click reads only that item. When enabled, manually returning to a window reads all existing window reminders; switching conversation editor tabs reads that session. Notification navigation suspends bulk acknowledgement.
setting.codexBeacon.openLocation: Where notification clicks open the session. Sidebar mode focuses the target window before requesting the Codex session; a detected focus change preserves unread state.
setting.codexBeacon.localCodexHome: Codex home for local VS Code folders. Empty uses CODEX_HOME, then ~/.codex. Only VS Code-origin sessions are collected.
setting.codexBeacon.localPythonPath: Local Python executable, without arguments. Empty automatically detects the Windows launcher or Python installed in standard user/system directories and PATH.
setting.codexBeacon.localSourceLabel: Source label for notifications from local VS Code windows.
setting.codexBeacon.localCollectorEnable: Collect VS Code Codex sessions in trusted local folders. SSH/container windows do not start local collection.
setting.codexBeacon.soundOnDone: Play sound when a response ends (on by default). Clicking and acknowledging are silent. Response completion does not mean the overall goal or a background job has finished.
setting.codexBeacon.desktopOnDone: Show a Windows desktop notification when a response ends. Off by default; color, unread state and sound remain available. Approval/question alerts follow the main desktop notification setting.
setting.codexBeacon.localCacheRetentionD: Local collector notification-cache retention (1–30 days). Expiry runs while collection is active; original Codex conversations are untouched.
setting.codexBeacon.historyRetentionDays: Local shared notification-history and deduplication retention (1–30 days). Default: 7 days, at most 200 history entries. Legacy caches expire using file modification time.
setting.codexBeacon.language: Follow the VS Code display language by default, or choose Chinese or English. Menus, tasks, alerts and logs follow the selected language.
setting.codexBeacon.groupBy: Group by project directory and source, one task per turn; history keeps the unread/read notification list.
setting.codexBeacon.modelPrices: Override final USD prices per million tokens by exact model name; custom prices are not multiplied by service-tier factors.
setting.codexBeacon.pricingContext: Default estimates use official short-context prices; choose long for long-context rates. This selection applies to all built-in model prices.
setting.codexBeacon.pricingTier: auto uses the logged service tier, falling back to standard; override for your actual tier. API estimates are not subscription or provider bills.
